verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests a written maintenance guide covering the controls for pricing-card outline and button colors.
First target-specific delivery claim: the freelancer reports sending a snapshot showing how to modify the outline and button colors.
The client adds concrete acceptance conditions that the guide identify the exact code control and be delivered in an accessible format; no prior keys become obsolete.
First concrete post-delivery failure: the client cannot open the document and cannot determine the specific color control to edit.
Target-specific post-failure claim: after providing alternate links, the freelancer identifies the linked material as the color-changing instructions.
